correctness.independent_check: independent_checks.py spacing_test: direct pairwise valuation checks of all masks lengths 1..16, independent memoized recurrences, 1000 exact fourfold cases
correctness.rationale: Every odd-valuation permitted support lies within one index parity; halving indices swaps required parity of valuations. For even valuation, the two parity subsequences are independent, proving F(n)=G(ceil n/2)+G(floor n/2)-1 and G(n)=F(ceil n/2)F(floor n/2), with base F(0)=G(0)=1 and F(1)=G(1)=2. Thus F(4n)=2F(n)^2-1. Hyperbolic cosine doubles give exact values on r4^m, distinct normalized constants arcosh(2) and arcosh(3)/sqrt(2). Monotonicity gives log F(n)=Theta(sqrt n); uniform at-most-2sqrt(n) support forces unique invariant delta_zero; incompatible neighboring period valuations rule out nonzero periodic points; superpolynomial subexponential word growth excludes soficity. Independently direct-brute counted both rules for n<=16 and tested fourfold for n<=1000.
